name: 会話のメッセージを個別に選択
prompt:
Create a standalone Japanese selected-message row on a clean white canvas, exactly 390 × 104 px in layout (wide 3.75:1 aspect). Use the Japanese native preview as the exact target for dimensions, spacing, colors, copy and type. Use the source crop to preserve the selected-message concept and the green check-circle marker. No phone frame, watermark, or extra labels.

Exact text: 明日は一日空いています。 / みなさんの予定はどうですか？ / 00:32.

Layout: a small solid green circle with a white check at x≈18, y≈32, diameter≈22. To its right, place one pale-mint rounded message bubble at x≈59, y≈12, width≈271, height≈76. Inside, align the two Japanese text lines to the upper-left in dark Meiryo-like sans serif, comfortable 14px size and 24px line spacing. Place muted-gray 00:32 at the lower-right of the bubble. Keep the bubble and selection marker on the same horizontal row, with generous white space around the compact component.

The original message does not contain underlined or otherwise marked hyperlink text. Keep both Japanese message lines dark; do not make them blue. Preserve the green selection check-circle and pale-mint bubble colors from the native preview. Keep all text crisp and exactly as written; do not invent other controls, timestamps, avatars, borders, or shadows.
reviewNotes: Exact Japanese copy and selected green check; no link text. 2048x768 canvas has excess vertical padding and the row sits too far right compared with the 390x104 preview.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
